summary: LEIFRAS Co., Ltd., a Japanese foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K to disclose a change in its independent registered public accounting firm. The audit committee and board resolved on July 13 and August 14, 2026, respectively, not to renew WWC, P.C., effective after its Q3 2026 review, and to engage Forvis Mazars Japan Audit LLC for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. WWC's reports for 2024 and 2025 were unqualified, with no disagreements, but material weaknesses in internal controls over financial reporting were disclosed. This is a routine auditor-change report, not a special situation.
